outputs.reasoning: I identified the exact company from cyberark.com, then checked primary acquisition evidence on Palo Alto Networks' investor site. That page clearly distinguishes signing from closing and shows that the acquisition was completed on 2025-07-30, so the current lifecycle status as of 2026-09-30 is acquired by Palo Alto Networks. For financing, CyberArk had long since gone public in 2014, so the relevant 'latest venture equity round' had to be pre-IPO. The best public evidence retrieved points to a $40 million December 2011 round led by Goldman Sachs and JVP, but JVP later characterized that same deal as a secondary transaction, so I preserved that ambiguity in latest_round and uncertainties rather than overstating certainty.
